title: The First Form - Anthropos and Adam Kadmon
author: Ethan James Farrell
description: An exploration of the primordial human through the figures of the Anthropos and Adam Kadmon. The work considers how Gnostic and Kabbalistic traditions use the human image to think about origins, divinity and the structure of existence.
editionNote: Curator-supplied PDF and EPUB from the organised ebook collection. One format was converted from the other (PDF from EPUB).
